The declared wallet mediator sends authenticated processSyncChunk requests; reference mode is not native qualification.
The source storage TCP listener is stopped while chain, overlay and replacement services remain running.
Supported Lock/Unlock retires the native live wallet context; the ToDo client cache is cleared and reloaded.

The same unspent encrypted ToDo outpoint is reconstructed and decrypted from the replacement.
A ToDo redemption is serialized and stored by the replacement while the source listener remains unavailable.
The source listener is restored; caller retires the isolated replacement after evidence collection.

limitations: Native configured counterpart replacement; portable file formats and other wallets are separate profiles.
